messages:
Renee (People Ops): FYI were closing the SF office early today at 3pm due to the severe storm warning. Safety first 3268. Please avoid non-essential travel after 2:30pm.

Diego (Eng): Thanks for the heads up. Will managers mark anyone who needs to stay?

Renee (People Ops): If you have a critical on-call or hardware task that must be done on-site, let your manager escalate to Facilities. We will coordinate safe transport.

Noor (Security): Building security will lock external doors at 3:15pm. Badge-only access after that. If youre leaving, grab belongings earlier.

FacilitiesBot: Shuttle update: Last outbound shuttle to downtown at 14:45. On-demand ride credits issued for eligible hub-based staff. Book via Shuttle app and select "Storm Early Exit" tag.

Diego (Eng): Branches in LON/NYC unaffected?

Renee (People Ops): LON/NYC open as usual. This is SF-specific due to local alerts. If you are traveling cross-hub today, please check with your manager.

Noor (Security): If youre stranded at the office overnight due to canceled transit, Facilities has a limited emergency kit and a few hotel rooms reserved for essential personnel. DM Security to request.

Renee (People Ops): Remote work allowed tomorrow for staff who cannot make it in safely. Managers: be flexible and log any remote exceptions on the People Ops page. Well extend catered lunch credits to cover storm-related food costs if youre working from home.

CalendarBot: Event updated "SF Office Early Closure - Storm" by Renee. More info: https://intranet.redwood/alerts/1772003456

Renee (People Ops): TL;DR: SF office closes at 3pm today, badge access after 3:15, last shuttle 14:45, ride credits available, hotels for essential staff, DM People Ops/Security for help. Stay safe everyone. :umbrella_with_rain_drops:
